name: products
description: Physical product models (EU-market electronic displays) from Open Icecat and EPREL: provider-scoped identities, source-linked specifications, reviewable cross-provider matches, datasheet links and evidence-linked comparison.

query_examples.intent: Find a monitor by its model designation
query_examples.semantics: exact designation ignoring case and separators; one row per provider record, with identifier conflicts and match candidates

query_examples.intent: Which Icecat and EPREL records describe the same model
query_examples.semantics: deterministic candidates from designations and corroborating diagonal/resolution; never merged until a reviewer accepts
every value cites its record revision and locator; a row compares only on a shared attribute, mode, unit and label scheme

query_examples.intent: What did the label of this barcode declare on a date
query_examples.semantics: per provider the label revision current at the date: ingredients, allergens, nutrient values and claims quoted and cited (ODbL attribution for Open Food Facts); crowd-sourced and reference values side by side, never reconciled; linked notices or no notice on record

query_examples.intent: How has this food's label changed
query_examples.semantics: every label revision oldest first with its parts and citation

exclusions: nutrition scores, health ratings or rankings computed by Noesis
